name: Kaizo Babymon
purpose: Add the Kaizo Babymon preset to an existing FireRed randomiser.
apply_order: Select one Tier 1 starter from babymon-manifest.json using the deterministic planner.
Run the normal randomiser with the selected settings.
Apply the planned Tier 1-to-Tier 2 and Tier 2-to-Tier 3 destinations with babymon_rom.js or an equivalent writer.
Install native evolution services when targeting unmodified FireRed Rev 1.
Record seed, settings hash, planner version and destination table.

compatibility.expanded_or_relocated_roms: Validate table addresses before applying the writer
compatibility.other_randomisers: Use planner and manifest as portable interface; map National Dex IDs to engine species IDs.

note: A settings string alone cannot express the three forced randomized evolution tiers. The adapter/post-processing step is required.
